changes.detail: `getStream` takes an optional `range`, honored by the local, S3 and UploadThing adapters, and `parseByteRange` reads an HTTP `Range` header against a blob's size. An adapter that can't honor a range throws instead of returning the whole blob. Existing calls are unchanged.
changes.summary: Stream part of a blob, so video can seek
Independently enforce ZIP expansion, entry count, completeness and nesting limits before accepting ClamAV clean verdicts; ClamAV can otherwise silently skip oversized ZIP entries.
Document shared platform hosting and verify cancellation cannot commit a clean result.
Fail closed on malformed, truncated, premature, or oversized ClamAV replies; bound frames and release streams and sockets on cancellation or timeout.
Provide a queue-compatible inspection processor with revision-aware host callbacks and retryable unavailable verdicts.
Explicit private UploadThing ACL, bounded cancellable uploads, and retryable deletion failures.
